decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel will get the project description at the School Building Committee meeting Thursday evening and circulate it to the BOS; the School Building Committee will submit the warrant article, and the BOS expects everything in hand at its 12/3/2013 meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chief Marino said that a new radio frequency, once programmed, was told to cost approximately the figure printed.
budget_items.quote: they were told it would cost approximately $15,000 - $20,000 to do so.

budget_items.topic: Regional dispatch savings and staffing funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said savings from the move to the district stayed in Public Safety to fund a Desk Officer, and that additional Public Safety funding will have to be justified in the budget.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel reminded everyone that with the savings that were realized by going to the district were left in public safety.

budget_items.topic: Public Safety additional funding in the budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said the need for additional Public Safety funding will have to be justified during budget work.
budget_items.quote: as we work on the budget we will have to justify the need for additional funding within public safety.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chief Marino said a Voice over IP system would help but is very expensive and not requested in this year's Capital Plan.
budget_items.quote: it is very expensive and is not being asked for in this year's capital plan.

budget_items.topic: Capital Plan request for receiver and generator
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chief Marino asked for Capital Plan funds for a repeater receiver, which he considers a priority, and also asked for a stand-by generator for the Sunny Hill Rd. repeater site.
budget_items.quote: chief marino asked for capital plan funds to purchase a receiver for that which he believes should be a priority.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said new member communities would further reduce Lunenburg's assessment, which could supplement Police and Fire, but more time is needed before expansion.
budget_items.quote: which would further reduce lunenburg's assessment which could be used to supplement our police & fire dept.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No administrative fee was included for the Town because the administrative burden was felt to be very minimal; the IMA sells only excess credits at the purchase price.
budget_items.quote: we did not include any administrative fee that the town would have to do because we felt that it was very minimal.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo reported the last mile is estimated to cost the printed amount, with a bond bill and Federal money being sought to cover it.
budget_items.quote: which is estimated to be around $100m to do the last mile.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram reported MRPC will update Lunenburg's pavement management for a minimal fee; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: for a minimal fee mrpc will update all of the pavement management for lunenburg.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Ebersole reported the sewer line was privately funded by the Lancaster Ave residents group and accepted; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the sewer line on lancaster ave, which was privately funded by the lancaster ave residents group

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said the School Building Committee group would finalize the project budget at the MSBA meeting; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: where they will be finalizing the budget on the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were listed with three dollar amounts; the minutes do not clearly pair each amount with a warrant number, so the pairing is not stated.
Chief Sullivan said a direct caller-ID link from mobile phones would take time and money.
budget_items.quote: it would be a function of time and money to be able to do that.
